parts.html: The K-15 kitchen model brings a distinctive red color palette into contemporary kitchen design, combining expressive cabinetry, clean architectural lines, and practical island functionality.
Its bold appearance makes the kitchen a defining element of the interior, while the coordinated painted cabinet fronts maintain a cohesive and refined furniture composition.

The rich red finish introduces color and character without requiring excessive decorative details. Combined with neutral walls, natural wood, stone textures, and contemporary interior materials, the K-15 kitchen creates a distinctive residential environment.

The model features a straight-line kitchen configuration complemented by a separate island. The main cabinetry accommodates built-in appliances, work surfaces, and storage along one wall, while the island introduces an additional functional area for food preparation and everyday activities.
This arrangement is particularly suitable for contemporary apartments, spacious residential interiors, and private homes with open-plan kitchen and living areas.
With a total linear length of 6.9 meters, the K-15 kitchen provides generous cabinet space and flexibility for organizing the main kitchen functions.
Both the upper and lower cabinet fronts feature a painted finish. Their coordinated solid red color reinforces the clean geometry of the furniture and creates a unified contemporary appearance.
A porcelain stoneware countertop complements the red cabinetry with a contrasting material texture and provides a practical surface for everyday food preparation.
The main cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.

For comfortable everyday operation, the model includes Hettich soft-close hinges and Atira Hettich drawer systems. These components support smooth cabinet movement and convenient access to kitchen essentials.
The K-15 kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. Cabinet handles are included, while lift mechanisms and pull-out cargo storage are not part of the standard configuration.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments, private residences, and contemporary residential interiors in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-15 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, architectural features, appliance requirements, and storage preferences.
The kitchen island dimensions, cabinet configuration, and work surfaces can be adjusted to suit the layout and functional requirements of the space.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
Order your K-15 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and create a distinctive contemporary interior combining red cabinetry, a functional island, and custom-made kitchen furniture.
